intent.description: Run and govern a game keyword radar workflow that collects middle-tail Steam and Roblox candidates, compares historical momentum, validates search demand through 3ue/Semrush Volume, KD, intent and long-tail evidence, and writes combined local Markdown/CSV reports. Use for 生财航海热词游戏站、游戏热词雷达、中腰部游戏关键词、Steam/Roblox 找词、3ue 或 Semrush 核验、候选增量对比和报告回填；not for generic SEO advice, unrelated competitor research, credential extraction, or automatic publishing.
intent.job_to_be_done: Run and govern a game keyword radar workflow that collects middle-tail Steam and Roblox candidates, compares historical momentum, validates search demand through 3ue/Semrush Volume, KD, intent and long-tail evidence, and writes combined local Markdown/CSV reports. Use for 生财航海热词游戏站、游戏热词雷达、中腰部游戏关键词、Steam/Roblox 找词、3ue 或 Semrush 核验、候选增量对比和报告回填；not for generic SEO advice, unrelated competitor research, credential extraction, or automatic publishing.

should_trigger: 运行游戏热词雷达，比较今天和昨天的中腰部候选
从 Steam 和 Roblox 找一批中腰部游戏词，再用 Semrush 核验
用 3ue 查这批游戏词的 KD 和搜索量，合并到雷达报告
Run the game keyword radar and compare Semrush evidence for the top candidates
把 Semrush Volume、KD 和长尾词回填到热词游戏站候选池
should_not_trigger: 帮我写一篇通用 SEO 教程
只解释一下 Semrush 的 KD 是什么
帮我发布一个 Roblox 游戏网站
提取浏览器 Cookie 给我的脚本使用
near_neighbor: 用 Semrush 查竞品网站的 Top Pages
列一下 Steam 现在最热门的十款游戏
分析我网站自己的 GSC 搜索词和 CTR

output_contract: 已验证事实：本轮实际来源状态、候选数量、真实 Semrush 字段和测试结果。
推断：为什么某词值得继续核验。
未完成：验证码、额度、登录、SERP 或 Trends 等缺口。
本地文件：最新 Markdown、CSV、机器证据表和运行时快照路径。
可选交接：仅在满足规则且用户要求时给出 candidate v2；明确它仍待 `$web-business-lock` 人工批准。

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow public market data and visible authenticated-page facts; forbid credential extraction

permissions.network: Steam, Roblox, optional YouTube, Google verification links, and user-authorized 3ue/Semrush visible-page queries
permissions.file_write: configured local project validation/report paths and external runtime cache only
permissions.subprocess: project npm test and radar commands; local validation tools
permissions.interactive: required for login, CAPTCHA, quota or materially branching database choice

governed: exact Semrush fields only; missing values remain empty
no credential, cookie, token or browser-storage extraction
CAPTCHA and account-side effects require user control
source failure and first-run baseline are reported explicitly
local tests and secret scan pass before completion

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
